title: When the Sigil Sings
premise: Ada Marchetti poisons herself nightly so the crown can eat safely, but her real work is secret: she keeps the ledgers of the Vellum Guild, which trades in impossible things — bottled storms, borrowed years, names that were never spoken. When a prophecy written a century ago surfaces naming tonight's date, a tinker named Wren Solano, as the one who 'opens the sealed door,' Ada realizes the guild has been hiding him from the moment he was born. Pursued by the Ashen Court's inquisitors and betrayed by her own guildmaster, Ada must choose between the found family that raised her and the truth: Wren is not the prophecy's hero but its key, and using him will reignite the war that created the guild. In the end Ada rewrites the ledger itself, trading her own recorded name to seal the door with Wren alive — and wakes to a world where only he remembers who she was.
about_author: Felix Sterling is the pen name of a former line cook who spent six years writing fantasy on the backs of order tickets during slow dinner services. They live near a harbor city they refuse to name, where they collect antique ledgers and feed the gulls too generously.

chapters.title: The Taster's Oath
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. We open mid-service as Ada tastes a suspect dish for the queen, then slips away to the Vellum Guild's back rooms to enter impossible acquisitions into the ledgers. Establishes her double life, her immunity built dish by dish, and her loyalty to guildmaster Corvane, who saved her from the streets. Emotional beat: belonging purchased through secrecy.

chapters.title: A Date Written in Ash
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Cataloguing a recovered century-old prophecy book, Ada finds tonight's date inked in faded script — and beside it, a description of the man she is meeting at dusk: Wren Solano, a tinker with a burn-scarred left hand. She goes anyway, torn between duty and curiosity. Emotional beat: dread braided with longing; the first crack in her ordered world.

chapters.title: Wren
chapters.summary: Alternating POV begins. Wren's chapter shows his ordinary life fracturing: clocks stop around him, strangers bow to him by mistake, and a hooded figure leaves a vellum scrap bearing his own handwriting — dated before his birth. He seeks out the woman from the market who stared at him like a ghost. Emotional beat: uncanny isolation meeting cautious connection.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Ada hides Wren in the guildhouse and shows him the ledgers, including an entry from 100 years ago listing 'W. Solano' among assets never delivered. Corvane catches them and orders Wren handed to the Ashen Court's inquisitors for 'safekeeping.' Emotional beat: Ada's first open defiance; loyalty tested against conscience.

chapters.title: What the Guild Owes
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Fleeing with Ada, Wren learns the guild's founding sin: it was built on a bargain that ended the last war by sealing something beneath the capital — and the seal requires a Solano bloodline heir. The inquisitors burn a safehouse behind them. Emotional beat: guilt and wonder as Wren realizes his whole life was arranged collateral.

chapters.title: Found Family, Forged Papers
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Hiding in the tasters' quarter, Ada gathers her unlikely circle — a disgraced alchemist, a deaf lockmaker, her fellow taster Sefa — who shelter the fugitives without question. Quiet interlude of warmth and banter before the storm; Ada admits she cannot remember her life before the guild. Emotional beat: found family crystallizing just as it becomes a target.

chapters.title: Corvane's Confession
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Captured and brought before Corvane, Ada learns the cruelest entry in the ledger: her own name, acquired as a child in payment for a debt — her memory traded so she would serve without question. Corvane begs her to give up Wren, insisting the seal failing means war. Emotional beat: betrayal and grief; identity itself revealed as a transaction.

chapters.title: The Sealed Door
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The inquisitors force Wren to the vault beneath the palace to open the door; Ada and the found family mount a desperate rescue through the taster's tunnels. The door opens — and what emerges is not a monster but the guild's first guildmaster, kept alive a century as the war's true architect. Emotional beat: climax of revelation; every alliance inverted.

chapters.title: Rewriting the Entry
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. The ancient guildmaster moves to claim Wren and restart the war; Ada seizes the master ledger and invokes the guild's oldest law — any entry may be amended by its keeper, at equivalent cost. She trades her recorded name, her history, her place in every memory, to close the door forever. Emotional beat: sacrifice as authorship; inheritance refused and rewritten.

chapters.title: When the Sigil Sings
chapters.summary: Wren's POV, coda. The war stays buried; the guild reforms under Sefa's hand. Wren alone remembers Ada — the amendment erased everyone else's memory of her — and finds one unlogged page in her handwriting: a recipe, a joke, a promise. He begins a new ledger with her name as its first entry. Emotional beat: mourning transformed into keeping; love outlasting record.
